message: The other night, I found myself in the middle of a blackout—no lights, no power, just the sound of my fridge quietly mourning its contents. I rummaged through my drawers and, to my delight, discovered a trusty little power bank I had forgotten about! It kept my phone charged so I could catch up on a favorite show using my tablet, and I even dug out a lantern for some cozy light. It turned a potentially frustrating evening into a little adventure instead. Have you had any small wins during a power outage that turned things around?
